abstract: In short, the comparison of the arms gives these main findings. Overall, Cardivel lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Cardivel lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. This comparison was run at the Oakfield Family Cohort.

Table 6. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Systolic drop | 10.5 | 5.2 | 250 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 8.0 | 4.0 | 250 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 10.4 | 5.2 | 250 |
